related.title: Laura Maersk 甲醇貨櫃船
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以岸電功率與線電流建立起點，接到生活負載與補能分帳的系統介面，最後用船岸雙方介面證據表整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Shore-power demand and line current, connect through Hotel-load and recharge accounting, then integrate evidence using Ship/shore interface evidence matrix. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 港口岸電系統介面
history.text: 本專題以岸電功率與線電流建立起點，接到生活負載與補能分帳的系統介面，最後用船岸雙方介面證據表整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Shore-power demand and line current, connect through Hotel-load and recharge accounting, then integrate evidence using Ship/shore interface evidence matrix. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以船岸介面圖比較電壓頻率、功率、時間窗與通訊資料，練習需求核對而不涉及實際接線。 在岸電介面與泊位負載數位室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Compare voltage/frequency, power, time windows and communications on a ship/shore interface map without live wiring. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Shore-power interface and berth-load studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
